summary: Wraps a file seek on a handle resolved from index a1 via sub_595A1F. On handle failure stores the error code 9 through TLSOffsetGetter and returns -1. Performs a 64-bit SetFilePointer seek: high 32 bits passed as a3, low 32 bits assigned from the return value. If the low 32 bits are -1 and GetLastError() is non-zero, routes the error through ErrorIDLookupTable and returns -1. On success clears bit 2 of the file-handle-table flag byte at dword_8D4920[a1>>5] + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4, then returns the full 64-bit position.

local_names.this: file-index parameter a1 identifying a table entry
local_names.lDistanceToMove: 64-bit seek result; high dword preset from a3, low dword from SetFilePointer

operations.description: Resolves the file handle for index a1 by calling sub_595A1F
If the resolved handle equals -1 (invalid), stores error code 9 through TLSOffsetGetter and returns -1
Calls SetFilePointer with the handle, low 32 bits of the offset (a2), the high 32 bits at &lDistanceToMove+1 (a3), and the move method; assigns the returned low 32 bits into lDistanceToMove
If the low 32 bits of the result equal -1 and GetLastError() is non-zero, passes the error to ErrorIDLookupTable and returns -1
Clears bit 2 of the flag byte at dword_8D4920[a1>>5] + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4 (the file-handle-table entry for a1)
Invoked by sub_595F11 as the error-checked file-positioning path
